paragraphs.source_en:
Who that hath understanding would praise Cleobulus the man of Lindus for his pitting of the
might of a gravestone against the ever-running rivers and the flowers of the Spring, against
the flame of sun and of golden moon, and against the eddies of the ocean-wave? All these are
subject to the Gods; but a stone, even mortal hands may break it. This is the rede of a fool.
 (Loeb trans.)
